schemaMatches.quantity: per-view hierarchical depth pyramid of the *minimum* (farthest) device Z over each 2x2 depth quad and over all children
schemaMatches.units: device Z in [0,1] (reversed Z: larger = nearer; 0 = far plane)
schemaMatches.coordinateSpace: HZB texture UV [0,1] over HZBSize(mip0); viewport -> HZB scales by ViewRect.Size()/(2*HZBSize)

transforms.name: mipReduce
transforms.expression: mip m = min over the 2x2 children of mip m-1; HZBSize=max(pow2(ViewRect)/2,1); NumMips=max(floor(log2(max(HZBSize))),1)

mathTerms: Reversed Z: min DeviceZ = furthest surface (HZB.usf:256,277).
CS path can also fold VisBuffer depth before the reduce (HZB.usf:250-253).
Capture 1048576 B = base mip 1024x512x2; the full mip chain is larger, so the descriptor byte count covers mip0 only.
gaps: Exact view extent is not in ResourceDescs metadata; 1024x512 is derived from the captured byte count and HZBSize=pow2/2.

fields.name: FurthestDeviceZ
fields.decode: min of the 2x2 device-Z quad; mip m = min of the four children; no FP16 rounding-up
